SELECT CORP_ID, BANK_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CORP_ID, BANK_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CORP_ID, BANK_ID ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
*   INTO BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_WITH_DUP_20231207
FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE; --Target table to remove duplicate
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate
UPDATE BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_WITH_DUP_20231207 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1
